fix_subject: fix: revert the 25-round tool cap on agents with output_schema and tools
intro_subject: fix: harden SetModelResponseTool fallback to prevent infinite loops
what_broke: A hard cap of 25 consecutive tool rounds forced agents with output_schema plus tools to give a final answer after 24 rounds with no warning, breaking legitimately long tool chains.
evidence_quote: which broke agents that legitimately need longer tool chains
replay_notes: Easy: run LlmAgent with output_schema and a tool at intro^ and intro on a task needing more than 25 sequential tool calls.

fix_subject: fix: revert the change about giving a cloned LlmAgent tools for its own sub-agents
intro_subject: fix: give a cloned LlmAgent tools for its own sub-agents
what_broke: Cloned LlmAgents that had replaced stock sub-agent tools got a second stock tool per sub-agent, so the model saw two tools for one sub-agent and could invoke it through the wrong one.
evidence_quote: the model saw two tools for one sub-agent and the sub-agent could be invoked through the wrong one
replay_notes: Moderate: needs agent with custom sub-agent tools, clone(), then delegation; a re-land (61a4dc64) followed the next day.

fix_subject: fix: revert the A2A guard that broke every HITL tool confirmation
intro_subject: fix: reject tool confirmations arriving over A2A
what_broke: Agents served over A2A could no longer satisfy human-in-the-loop tool confirmations because the confirmation processor returned early whenever a2a_metadata was present.
evidence_quote: every tool requiring confirmation was permanently blocked
replay_notes: Moderate: serve an agent with a require_confirmation tool over A2A and send an approval.

fix_subject: fix(workflow): rerun rerun_on_resume nodes as soon as any interrupt is resolved
intro_subject: fix(workflow): wait for all direct interrupts before rerunning rerun_on_resume nodes
what_broke: A rerun_on_resume node with several interrupts stayed WAITING until all were answered, so workflows waiting on alternative events never resumed.
evidence_quote: the interrupts that are never triggered stay unresolved forever and the node never resumes
replay_notes: Moderate: workflow with a node raising several interrupts, answer one.

fix_subject: fix(a2a): revert persisting streamed RemoteA2aAgent output without last_chunk
intro_subject: fix(a2a): persist streamed RemoteA2aAgent output without last_chunk
what_broke: RemoteA2aAgent emitted an extra aggregated non-partial event after streamed chunks, so integrations forwarding both showed the streamed answer twice.
replay_notes: Needs a streaming A2A remote agent and a client that forwards all events.

fix_subject: fix: Rollback instruction util refactoring as its breaking internal customers
intro_subject: feat(utils): Add support for nested state access in template injection
what_broke: Rewritten instruction template injection (nested state access, escaped braces) broke internal customers; rolled back after two follow-up fixes (20ba01c2, 9ecbaed5 'Fix regression in instructions_utils placeholder matching').
evidence_quote: Rollback instruction util refactoring as its breaking internal customers
replay_notes: Easy: instruction strings with {placeholders} and literal braces rendered at intro^ vs intro; inspect prompt text.

fix_subject: fix: Fix regression in instructions_utils placeholder matching
intro_subject: fix: Fix instructions_utils matching invalid nested paths
what_broke: Placeholder matching in instruction templates regressed (escaped/invalid brace handling), changing the rendered instruction text; message gives no detail.
evidence_quote: Fix regression in instructions_utils placeholder matching
replay_notes: Easy: render instruction templates with escaped braces; introducing commit is inferred from file history only.

intro_subject: feat: implementation of LLM context compaction
what_broke: Compaction handling and event sorting in history assembly (_get_contents) caused problems in complex cases and was rolled back.
evidence_quote: The sorting may cause problems in complex cases so rolling it back.
replay_notes: Moderate: long session with compaction events, inspect assembled contents; intro commit inferred from path history.

fix_subject: fix: Undo adding MCP tools output schema to FunctionDeclaration
intro_subject: fix: Propagate MCP tools output schema to FunctionDeclaration
what_broke: MCP tool output schemas were added to the FunctionDeclaration shown to the model and then undone; the message gives no reason.
evidence_quote: Undo adding MCP tools output schema to FunctionDeclaration
replay_notes: Needs an MCP server tool with outputSchema; reason for undo is not stated, so weak evidence.

fix_subject: fix(tools): disable default httpx 5s timeout in OpenAPI tool _request
what_broke: Migrating RestApiTool from requests to httpx imposed httpx's 5s default timeout, causing ReadTimeout errors on slow API calls.
evidence_quote: This regression blocked users from upgrading past 1.23.0.
replay_notes: Easy with a local slow HTTP server and an OpenAPI toolset. Body cites PR #2872 as the migration; sha mapped by path history.

fix_subject: fix: Keep query params embedded in OpenAPI paths when using httpx
what_broke: The requests-to-httpx migration dropped query strings embedded in the URL path, breaking ApplicationIntegrationToolset.
evidence_quote: The migration from requests to httpx in v1.24.0 broke ApplicationIntegrationToolset
needs_external: HTTP API with embedded query path
replay_notes: Easy with local HTTP server and an OpenAPI spec whose path has a query string.

fix_subject: fix: remove per-response Gemini cleanup causing thread-safety race (#7797)
intro_subject: feat: support Gemini 3.0 thought signatures in Gemini model (#5454)
what_broke: Per-response cleanup blocks added for Gemini 3.0 closed and nulled the shared client after each response, causing SSL/TLS failures under concurrent load.
evidence_quote: Gemini client thread-safety bug causing SSL/TLS failures under concurrent load
needs_external: none beyond Gemini key; concurrent runs
replay_notes: Moderate: run several concurrent Gemini agent runs sharing one model at intro; body says cleanup was added in #5454, sha mapped by PR number.

fix_subject: fix: use stream_events instead of stream_steps for AG-UI teams (#7938)
what_broke: A typo in the rename to stream_events (stream_steps) was swallowed by **kwargs, so teams run via AG-UI missed all intermediate streaming events for about 7 months.
evidence_quote: Teams via AG-UI have been missing intermediate events (tool calls, reasoning steps, member delegations) for ~7 months
replay_notes: Moderate: run a Team through the AG-UI interface and inspect streamed events; not an LLM-quality issue.

fix_subject: fix: handle None headers when merging init headers in MCP tools (#7548)
intro_subject: fix: apply header_provider headers during MCP initialization (#7507)
what_broke: MCPTools/MultiMCPTools init crashed with TypeError when header_provider returned a dict while server_params.headers was None.
evidence_quote: initialization crashes before the first network call with `TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not a mapping`
replay_notes: Easy: MCPTools with header_provider and no static headers against a local MCP server.

fix_subject: fix: revert IntermediateRunContentEvent changes done in teams (#7295)
intro_subject: fix: Coda integration fixes (CodingTools, Slack, team streaming, learning) (#7208)
what_broke: Wrapping member RunContent events as IntermediateRunContentEvent in team streaming lost member identity, so member responses appeared to stop streaming in the front end.
evidence_quote: The wrapping broke the FE event handling
needs_external: front end consuming events (or inspect event stream)
replay_notes: Moderate: stream a Team with member agents and compare event types; intro commit is a bundled multi-change PR.

fix_subject: fix: aws claude legacy tool format [v2] (#4796)
what_broke: The Anthropic tool-format change broke the legacy tool format used by AWS Claude; message says only 'regression from #4780'.
replay_notes: Needs Bedrock Claude with tools; check tool schema formatting at intro vs intro^.

intro_subject: fix: remove duplicate messages in OpenAIResponses (#4739)
what_broke: The duplicate-message removal in OpenAIResponses regressed; message gives no detail.
replay_notes: Needs diff reading to know what to exercise; weak evidence text.
